history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A vibrant, anime-style promotional poster for "TrippieRed Store." The central focus is Roronoa Zoro from One Piece, depicted in three variations. On the left, Zoro grins confidently, holding two swords. In the center, he bites down on a sword, his expression intense. On the right, he winks with a smirk, also wielding swords. All three Zoros wear their signature green robes and have green spiky hair. The background is a dynamic, abstract mix of red and black with some green circular elements. The store name, "TrippieRed Store," is emblazoned across the bottom half of the poster in large, bold, white, 3D lettering with a red outline and a subtle pink glow. Below the store name, a teal rectangular box contains the text "CONTACT PERSON" in white, followed by a WhatsApp icon and the phone number "089520642657" in white. The bottom edge of the poster has a repeating pattern of "TrippieRed Store - TrippieRed Sto". The overall mood is energetic and bold, with a strong emphasis on action and character appeal. The lighting is bright and highlights the characters, creating a sense of excitement. The color palette is dominated by red, green, black, and white, with accents of purple and gold from the swords.
